Macrons

Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks

soup noun

also broth, stock, chicken stock, vegetable soup, noodle soup, hot soup

classical

Traupman 73
Traupman 68
Traupman 70

jūs, jūris n.

noun, third declension

soup, broth

A homonym of jūs, “right, law”.

Other words

  • jūsculum, jūsculī n. — a little broth

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Cato, Agr. 156.7: jūsculum frīgidum (Lewis & Short); Andresian p. 9; Traupman 70; Traupman 73

    The diminutive of jūs; the lexicon gives it, after Traupman, for a sauce.

  • sorbitiō, sorbitiōnis f. — broth, a drink to sip

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 383

Examples

  • Domum reversa avia jūs coxit, quod Lūsitānī caldo verde vocant, id est jūs viride

    Back home, Grandma made the soup the Portuguese call caldo verde, that is, green soupcomposed

  • In culīnā jūs ex holeribus in ōllā foculō impositā calēbat, quod in crāstinum servātum est.

    In the kitchen a vegetable soup was keeping warm in a pot on the stove; it was kept for the next day.composed

  • jūs collȳricum

    noodle soupTraupman 72

  • jūs fervēns

    hot soupTraupman 73

  • Quod jūs habēs hodiē?

    What kind of soup do you have today?Traupman 68

  • jūs gallīnāceum

    chicken stockcomposed

See also sauce, gravy boat, keep for tomorrow, cooking pot, soup bowl.
